response.sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT si.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY si.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.rate) AS average_excess FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate;
